{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.20

|gr1= Vehicles

|descr= Customise given kart and its driver.

|s1= [kart,number,livery,raceTeam] call [[BIS_fnc_initVehicleKart]]

|p1=kart: [[Object]]

|p2=number: [[Array]] - (Optional, default [-1,-1]) kart number from 00 to 99

|p3=livery: [[Number]] - (Optional, default ''Random'') kart livery. A integer from 0 to 9

|p4=raceTeam: [[Number]] - (Optional, default ''Matches the livery'') driver uniform

|r1= [[Boolean]] - always [[true]]

|x1= <sqf>[BIS_kart, [9,7], -1, -1] call BIS_fnc_initVehicleKart;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_initVehicle]] [[Arma 3 Karts]]
}}
